info.title: وريد / Warid — HTTP API
info.description:
Generated from the route files and the Zod schemas the server validates with —
run `npx tsx scripts/generate-openapi.ts` after changing a route.

Read `docs/api/README.md` first: it carries the conventions this spec cannot
express — Baghdad-day bucketing, the money contract, refresh-token rotation
and its reuse detection, and what is not built yet.

This is the FULL surface, most of which serves the web dashboards. The
native app signs in as a PATIENT and can only reach `Auth`, `Public` and
`Patient` — hand the mobile team `openapi.mobile.json` instead, which is
this spec filtered to exactly those three.

tags.name: Referrals
tags.description: The four referral documents inside a medical complex

bearerAuth.description: Access token from POST /api/auth/token. Valid 15 minutes; refresh with POST /api/auth/token/refresh. If this header is present its verdict is final — the server never falls back to a cookie.

error.description: Human-readable Arabic. Not stable — do not branch on it.

code.description: The machine-readable contract. Branch on this.

details.description: Present on VALIDATION_FAILED. `field` is a dot path into the body you sent.

nextCursor.description: Opaque keyset cursor over (createdAt, id). Do not parse or construct it.

total.description: Only when explicitly requested — COUNT(*) is a scan.
